entities.name: TNFRSF11B (osteoprotegerin)
observations: Plasma osteoprotegerin was higher in diabetic hypertensive participants with impaired GLS; it independently predicted impaired GLS in the reported analysis (P=0.001).

entities.name: PMID:25442456
observations: 2014 speckle-tracking study of 86 diabetic hypertensive patients and 30 nondiabetic hypertensive controls; reported preserved ejection fraction in the target population and an association between plasma OPG and impaired GLS.

entities.name: PMID:25442456 OPG-GLS result
observations: In diabetic hypertensive patients, impaired GLS (≤18.5) was associated with higher OPG (P<0.001); OPG independently predicted impaired GLS (P=0.001), and >6.45 pmol/L identified GLS ≤18.5. This observational result supports association, not causality.
